```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

history <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet")
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(markets, by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
    time_bucket = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30-90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7-30 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1-7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    time_bucket = factor(
      time_bucket,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30-90 days",
        "7-30 days",
        "1-7 days",
        "Final day"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(absolute_error),
    n_snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

accuracy

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2563EB", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#2563EB", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.05,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "#2563EB",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of final-day forecasts",
    subtitle = "Market probabilities on the day of resolution",
    x = "Forecast probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = cut(
      probability,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_probability = mean(probability),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "#2563EB", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#2563EB") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 10) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Do final-day forecasts match actual outcomes?",
    subtitle = "Dashed line shows perfect calibration; points represent 10-percentage-point bins",
    x = "Mean predicted probability",
    y = "Fraction that resolved YES",
    size = "Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
